draft.subject: Notes that hold up when the payer asks
draft.body:
Ingrid,

Most denials happen weeks after the visit, when a payer pulls the note and decides the documentation doesn't support the code.

JotPsych checks every note against 150+ payer rules before you submit it. It flags audit risk in real time and surfaces the CPT and ICD codes your documentation actually supports.

The goal is simple: accurate coding, fewer denials, and notes that stand up to an audit.

It works with any EHR. Or replaces it entirely. No migration required — you can be up in 5 minutes and run it beside the system you have today.

If audit defensibility matters to your practice, I'd be glad to walk you through how JotAudit works.

Best,
[Name]
JotPsych

--
